notes:
- A title that leaves after a few seconds leaves on a camera change when one is close, and the first caption comes in on the very frame it goes: no empty frames, no overlap.
- The camera never jumps for a moment when a face is missed for a frame, never shows one frame of the old framing on a cut, and goes straight to the new person on a cut instead of holding on an empty place.
- No clip shows a single frame of the shot before or after one of its cuts.
- Studio Podcast: caption lines stop at every cut and change of speaker, and punch-ins land on the camera cut instead of a frame after it.
- A wide shot whose only faces are on the screen behind the people is still a wide of those people, zoomed on them.
